definitions.explanation: To rise from a sitting or lying position.

examples.japanese: {椅子|いす}から{立|た}ち{上|あ}がる。
examples.english: To stand up from a chair.

examples.japanese: {困難|こんなん}に{立|た}ち{上|あ}がる。
{床|ゆか}から{立|た}ち{上|あ}がる。
examples.english: To stand up from the floor.

examples.japanese: {民衆|みんしゅう}が{立|た}ち{上|あ}がった。
ゆっくり{立|た}ち{上|あ}がった。
{不正|ふせい}に{立|た}ち{上|あ}がる。
{挨拶|あいさつ}のために{立|た}ち{上|あ}がった。
{再|ふたた}び{立|た}ち{上|あ}がった。
{名前|なまえ}を{呼|よ}ばれて、{急|いそ}いで{立|た}ち{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: When my name was called, I quickly stood up.

examples.japanese: {何度|なんど}{挫折|ざせつ}しても、そのたびに{立|た}ち{上|あ}がってきた。
examples.english: No matter how many times I've failed, I've risen again each time.

notes:
{立|た}ち{上|あ}がる is a compound verb meaning to stand up or to rise (take action).

TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive verb ({自動詞|じどうし}).

COMPONENTS:
- {立|た}つ: to stand
- {上|あ}がる: to go up

TWO MEANINGS:
1. Physical: to stand up from sitting/lying
2. Figurative: to rise up, take action, resist

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {椅子|いす}から{立|た}ち{上|あ}がる: to stand up from a chair
- {困難|こんなん}に{立|た}ち{上|あ}がる: to rise against difficulties
- {再|ふたた}び{立|た}ち{上|あ}がる: to rise again

CONTRAST:
- {立|た}ち{上|あ}がる: to stand up (intransitive)
- {立|た}ち{上|あ}げる: to start up, launch (transitive, e.g., a business)
